title: A Comparative Study on Thrust Map Estimation for Multirotor Aerial Vehicles — xNova bench files
creator: Francisco J. Anguita, Rafael Perez-Segui, Carmen DR.Pita-Romero, Miguel Fernandez-Cortizas, Javier Melero-Deza, Pascual Campoy
rights: Public research repository, no root license found in fixed tree. Use source links and independently computed summaries.
evidence: Bench files cover single-rotor and multirotor fixtures. Five timestamped logged CSVs plus two six-column map inputs. Comparisons measure row-level support and potential overlap. The author script data_assemble uses the comma default and skips files on failure. filter_data flips recorded thrust sign and applies strict inequalities. One map-input CSV uses semicolon delimiters.

joined_input_boundary: These sources do not establish an upstream unclamped torque demand, its post-limiter command and an independently calibrated shaft torque on a common time base.
